title: Reset Password
content: Users can reset their password from Settings > Security. Click reset password and follow verification steps sent to their email.

title: Refund Policy
content: Refunds are processed within five business days after approval. Users must submit refund requests through support.

title: Account Deletion
content: Users can permanently delete their account from profile settings. Deleted accounts cannot be recovered.

title: Subscription Plans
content: Premium subscription includes unlimited storage, priority customer support, and advanced analytics.

title: Support Contact
content: Users can contact customer support using email, phone support, or live chat available 24 hours.

title: Profile Update
content: Users can update profile details including name, email, and profile picture from account settings.
